topic: Check the enforcing guard in real sessions after release
detail: After SP-041 ships and orchd restarts: (1) sessions started while orchd was down or an older orchd ran have no pin file; once spaces are applied with the guard enforcing, their calls are refused (pin_missing) and they must be restarted; (2) in one Claude Code and one Codex session in a configured space, try a call into another job's folder and confirm the call is refused and the reason (rule id, no path) is shown; (3) confirm 'orch spaces enforce guard off' takes effect on the next call.
